 Daylight Saving Time Ends Tonight. It’s Time to Fall Back the Clocks, Check your Vehicles Lights, and Recalls
 Staff Writer 
 October 31, 2026 
 PainInThePass , Safety , TrafficSafety 
 SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA, CA. (Pain In The Pass) >>  Don’t forget that Daylight Saving Time ends tonight. Remember to turn those clocks back one hour. The change will happen on Sunday morning at 2am, while most of us are asleep you might need to set your clocks back one hour before going to bed on Saturday night. This means it will get dark an hour earlier around 5pm.
 Things to check or change: 
 • Remember to set your clocks back one hour.
 • Check and test your batteries in your smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors.
 • Inspect your headlights, turn signals, brake lights and taillights to make sure they are working properly. So you are safe on the roadway.
 • Check your tires air pressure and tire wear.
 Check on your vehicles recalls. Enter your vehicles VIN number at  NHTSA Recall Site  or  CheckTopProtect.org  to see if your vehicle has a open recall.
 • Change you clock in your vehicle. If you remember how too.
 • Be sure to check your emergency kit too for any food or bottles of water that might be near expiration.
